title: crepis albanica
intro: Crepis albanica, commonly known as Albanian Hawk's Beard, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues and fever, due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Crepis albanica are believed to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
